text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Gag me with a spoon! I'm done for…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: My skin is a mess. I should just bag my face…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Blech! I really need to be more careful about sunburn!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I should buy a sun hat, arm covers, and a sweet pair of sunglasses.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Aww, but I wish I could enjoy the nice weather more… Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky seems to be suffering from skin problems.
